verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is an account-level gate: only users with validated accounts can connect. That is not a per-device pairing or explicit approval step before a new device can see or control the screen, so it is an adjacent control. No evidence documents device pairing, approval prompts or trusted-device allowlisting.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen

citations.quote: Additionally, only users with validated accounts can establish a connection.
